visual_identity.core_identity: Rooted giant fungal organisms whose mushroom structure remains primary even when they shriek, lash tendrils, or act as predators.
visual_identity.silhouette: Thick rooted stalk or fungal base with broad cap, shelf, or colony forms; no walking humanoid body.
visual_identity.head_features: No animal or human head; cap, gills, pores, or tendrils provide variant identity.
visual_identity.body_shape: Rooted fungal body with variant-specific cap, stalk, shelves, tendrils, or resonant opening.
visual_identity.surface: Simple cap and stalk surfaces with sparse gill, spot, or pore detail.

accuracy_checks: no accidental humanoid or animal face appears
large fungal forms remain easy to color

known_failure_modes.symptom: fungus gains cute eyes or face
known_failure_modes.correction: remove facial features and restore cap/gill/tendril-based identity
keep a strong rooted cap-and-stalk body and make tendrils secondary
